identification: Victorian-style 'grandmother/grandfather' spoon-back gentleman's armchair: deep-buttoned balloon back with small carved floral crest, open scroll arms with carved knuckle terminals, serpentine seat rail, short carved cabriole front legs, upholstered in grey-green diamond-pattern fabric; plus a small round buttoned footstool on four turned bun feet, same fabric. Uniform orange-brown lacquered finish, crisp machine-looking carving and fresh even upholstery suggest a later 20th century reproduction (the type made in large numbers in Australia c1970-1990) rather than an 1860s original. Footstool also modern.
